# github_enterprise_cost_centers (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of GitHub enterprise cost centers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "github_enterprise_cost_centers" "active" {
  enterprise_slug = "example-enterprise"
  state           = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enterprise_slug` (String) The slug of the enterprise.

### Optional

- `state` (String) Filter cost centers by state. Valid values are 'all', 'active', and 'deleted'.

### Read-Only

- `cost_centers` (Set of Object) The list of cost centers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cost_centers))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--cost_centers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cost_centers`

Read-Only:
